meta.note: The phrasebook grown into a real one: situational chunks for the places a resident of Madeira actually stands in — the café counter, AIMA, the pharmacy, a rented flat, the mechanic. Whole constructions with the social wrapping included, because 'queria' opens more doors than 'quero'.

cards.term: queria um café, se faz favor
cards.note: queria (not quero) is the polite ask; um café alone means espresso
cards.ex_t: Bom dia, queria um café e um pastel de nata, se faz favor.
cards.ex_trans: Good morning, I'd like an espresso and a pastel de nata, please.

cards.note: the counter question is 'é para aqui ou para levar?'
cards.ex_t: É para levar, se faz favor.
cards.ex_trans: To take away, please.

cards.note: in Portugal you ask for the bill — it does not arrive on its own
cards.ex_t: Quando puder, a conta, se faz favor.
cards.ex_trans: When you have a moment, the bill please.

cards.term: o que é que me recomenda?
cards.note: the 'é que' is pure spoken pt-PT — questions sound bare without it
cards.ex_t: Nunca cá vim — o que é que me recomenda?
cards.ex_trans: I've never been here — what do you recommend?

cards.trans: do you have a table for two?
cards.ex_t: Boa noite, tem mesa para dois?
cards.ex_trans: Good evening, do you have a table for two?

cards.note: tipping is modest in Portugal — rounding up is plenty
cards.ex_t: Está incluído o serviço, ou deixo alguma coisa?
cards.ex_trans: Is service included, or shall I leave something?

cards.note: alérgica if you're a woman
cards.ex_t: Sou alérgico a marisco.
cards.ex_trans: I'm allergic to shellfish.

cards.note: Madeira's own order is a chinesa; garoto is the small one
cards.ex_t: Uma meia de leite e uma torrada, se faz favor.
cards.ex_trans: A coffee with milk and toast, please.

cards.note: the universal soft yes — to suggestions, times, substitutions
cards.ex_t: — Só temos de cerveja. — Pode ser.
cards.ex_trans: — We only have beer. — That works.

cards.note: estar a + infinitive — the pt-PT progressive, never 'estou vendo'
cards.ex_t: Ah, estou a ver, é já depois da rotunda.
cards.ex_trans: Ah I see, it's just after the roundabout.

cards.trans: I didn't understand / didn't catch that
cards.note: perceber is what Portugal says for catching what was said; entender exists here too, for understanding the sense of it
cards.ex_t: Desculpe, não percebi — pode repetir?
cards.ex_trans: Sorry, I didn't catch that — can you repeat?

cards.ex_t: Ainda estou a aprender — pode falar mais devagar?
cards.ex_trans: I'm still learning — can you speak more slowly?

cards.ex_t: Como é que se diz 'receipt' em português?
cards.ex_trans: How do you say 'receipt' in Portuguese?

cards.note: há for elapsed time — the mistake the coach corrects most
cards.ex_t: Estou cá há dois anos e ainda dou erros.
cards.ex_trans: I've been here two years and I still make mistakes.

cards.trans: go ahead! / good luck with it!
cards.note: encouragement, permission, sympathy — all in one word
cards.ex_t: — Posso passar? — Força!
cards.ex_trans: — May I get past? — Go ahead!

cards.note: closes any counter transaction
cards.ex_t: — Mais alguma coisa? — Não, é só isso.
cards.ex_trans: — Anything else? — No, that's all.

cards.note: or just 'quanto é?' at the till
cards.ex_t: Quanto é que custa o quilo das cerejas?
cards.ex_trans: How much is a kilo of cherries?

cards.note: multibanco is the national card network — everyone says it, nobody says 'cartão de crédito'
cards.ex_t: Aceita multibanco ou é só dinheiro?
cards.ex_trans: Do you take card or cash only?

cards.trans: can you give me a bag?
cards.note: bags cost a few cents — you will be asked 'quer saco?'
cards.ex_t: Pode-me dar um saco pequeno, se faz favor?
cards.ex_trans: Can you give me a small bag, please?

cards.note: obrigada if you're a woman — it agrees with the speaker
cards.ex_t: — Posso ajudar? — Estou só a ver, obrigado.
cards.ex_trans: — Can I help? — Just looking, thanks.

cards.trans: do you have it in a bigger size?
cards.note: menor for smaller; número for shoes
cards.ex_t: Gosto destes — tem em tamanho maior?
cards.ex_trans: I like these — do you have a bigger size?

cards.note: also for food samples at the market
cards.ex_t: Posso experimentar estas calças?
cards.ex_trans: Can I try these trousers on?

cards.note: keep o talão — the receipt
cards.ex_t: Queria devolver isto, tenho aqui o talão.
cards.ex_trans: I'd like to return this, I have the receipt here.

cards.note: paragem, not 'ponto de ônibus' — that's Brazil
cards.ex_t: Onde fica a paragem para o Funchal?
cards.ex_trans: Where is the stop for Funchal?

cards.ex_t: Este autocarro vai para o aeroporto?
cards.ex_trans: Does this bus go to the airport?

cards.note: chega for arrivals
cards.ex_t: A que horas parte o próximo barco para o Porto Santo?
cards.ex_trans: What time does the next boat to Porto Santo leave?

cards.term: pode parar aqui, se faz favor
cards.note: to the taxi driver
cards.ex_t: Pode parar aqui ao pé da igreja, se faz favor.
cards.ex_trans: You can stop here by the church, please.

cards.note: perdida if you're a woman
cards.ex_t: Desculpe, estou perdido — sabe onde fica o centro?
cards.ex_trans: Excuse me, I'm lost — do you know where the centre is?

cards.note: the hopeful follow-up: dá para ir a pé? — can I walk it?
cards.ex_t: O miradouro é longe daqui?
cards.ex_trans: Is the viewpoint far from here?

cards.note: the answer to every direction question in Portugal
cards.ex_t: É sempre em frente até à rotunda.
cards.ex_trans: Straight ahead until the roundabout.

cards.note: consulta is a medical appointment; marcação is the booking
cards.ex_t: Bom dia, tenho consulta marcada para as dez.
cards.ex_trans: Good morning, I have an appointment booked for ten.

cards.ex_t: Não me sinto bem desde ontem à noite.
cards.ex_trans: I haven't felt well since last night.

cards.note: estar com — the state you're in: com febre, com fome, com sono
cards.ex_t: Acho que estou com febre, vou medir.
cards.ex_trans: I think I have a fever, I'll check.

cards.term: tem alguma coisa para a tosse?
cards.trans: do you have anything for a cough?
cards.note: the pharmacy formula: para a dor, para a febre, para a garganta
cards.ex_t: Tem alguma coisa para a tosse seca?
cards.ex_trans: Do you have anything for a dry cough?

cards.note: receita is both prescription and recipe
cards.ex_t: Este é preciso receita, ou vende-se assim?
cards.ex_trans: Does this need a prescription, or is it sold as is?

cards.ex_t: Tenho seguro de saúde — precisa do cartão?
cards.ex_trans: I have health insurance — do you need the card?

cards.note: tratar de — to deal with; processo is your file at AIMA
cards.ex_t: Bom dia, venho tratar do meu processo de residência.
cards.ex_trans: Good morning, I've come about my residence application.

cards.trans: I have a booking for ten
cards.note: no appointment, no entry — the AIMA rule
cards.ex_t: Tenho marcação para as dez, em nome de Kirill.
cards.ex_trans: I have a booking for ten, under the name Kirill.

cards.ex_t: Para renovar, que documentos são precisos?
cards.ex_trans: To renew, which documents are needed?

cards.note: faltar works backwards like doer: falta-me — it is lacking to me
cards.ex_t: Está tudo, ou falta-me algum documento?
cards.ex_trans: Is everything there, or am I missing a document?

cards.note: what the clerk says right before 'volte amanhã'
cards.ex_t: Hoje não dá — o sistema está em baixo.
cards.ex_trans: Not today — the system is down.

cards.note: já + present — the polite way to chase anything
cards.ex_t: Enviei os papéis em maio — já tem resposta?
cards.ex_trans: I sent the papers in May — is there an answer yet?

cards.term: preciso de um comprovativo de morada
cards.trans: I need a proof of address
cards.note: the document every Portuguese process asks for
cards.ex_t: Para abrir conta preciso de um comprovativo de morada.
cards.ex_trans: To open an account I need a proof of address.

cards.trans: I'd like to open an account
cards.ex_t: Queria abrir uma conta à ordem.
cards.ex_trans: I'd like to open a current account.

cards.note: engolir — to swallow; the clitic sits after the verb in pt-PT
cards.ex_t: O multibanco engoliu-me o cartão, o que faço?
cards.ex_trans: The ATM swallowed my card, what do I do?

cards.trans: I'm looking for a place to rent
cards.note: arrendar for property; alugar for cars and boards
cards.ex_t: Procuro casa para arrendar perto do centro.
cards.ex_trans: I'm looking for a place to rent near the centre.

cards.note: despesas covers water, light, internet — ask before signing
cards.ex_t: A renda é 800 — as despesas estão incluídas?
cards.ex_trans: The rent is 800 — are utilities included?

cards.trans: when can I view the place?
cards.ex_t: Ainda está disponível? Quando posso ver a casa?
cards.ex_trans: Is it still available? When can I view it?

cards.note: estar a + infinitive again — report problems in the progressive
cards.ex_t: A torneira da cozinha está a pingar há uma semana.
cards.ex_trans: The kitchen tap has been dripping for a week.

cards.note: ficar sem — to be left without; also ficou sem água, sem rede
cards.ex_t: O prédio inteiro ficou sem luz.
cards.ex_trans: The whole building lost power.

cards.ex_t: A que horas nos encontramos amanhã?
cards.ex_trans: What time shall we meet tomorrow?

cards.trans: let's leave it for next time
cards.note: the graceful way to decline or postpone
cards.ex_t: Hoje não consigo — fica para a próxima!
cards.ex_trans: I can't today — next time!

cards.note: seals any plan
cards.ex_t: — Sexta às oito? — Combinado!
cards.ex_trans: — Friday at eight? — Deal!

cards.note: desculpe with strangers; desculpa with friends
cards.ex_t: Desculpa o atraso, o trânsito estava impossível.
cards.ex_trans: Sorry I'm late, the traffic was impossible.

cards.ex_t: — Quem ganhou ontem? — Não faço ideia.
cards.ex_trans: — Who won yesterday? — No idea.

cards.note: giro is the pt-PT word Brazil doesn't use — instant local points
cards.ex_t: Que giro, este miradouro!
cards.ex_trans: How lovely, this viewpoint!

cards.note: imenso as an intensifier is very pt-PT
cards.ex_t: Está imenso calor hoje no Funchal.
cards.ex_trans: It's really hot in Funchal today.

cards.note: vem aí — is on its way; also vem aí o autocarro
cards.ex_t: Leva o casaco, parece que vem aí chuva.
cards.ex_trans: Take your jacket, looks like rain is coming.

cards.note: rede — network, both phone and wifi
cards.ex_t: Ligo-te mais tarde, a rede aqui é fraca.
cards.ex_trans: I'll call you later, the signal here is weak.

cards.term: qual é a palavra-passe do wi-fi?
cards.note: palavra-passe, not 'senha' — that's the Brazilian word
cards.ex_t: Desculpe, qual é a palavra-passe do wi-fi?
cards.ex_trans: Excuse me, what's the wifi password?

cards.note: ligar — to call; present tense does the future's job in speech
cards.ex_t: Estou numa reunião, ligo-te mais tarde.
cards.ex_trans: I'm in a meeting, I'll call you later.

cards.note: clitic after the verb — 'me manda' sounds Brazilian
cards.ex_t: Quando chegares, manda-me mensagem.
cards.ex_trans: When you arrive, text me.

cards.note: pegar — to catch/start; at the mechanic's this is the opening line
cards.ex_t: De manhã o carro não pega à primeira.
cards.ex_trans: In the morning the car won't start first try.

cards.ex_t: Furou-se um pneu na estrada para o Paul da Serra.
cards.ex_trans: I got a flat on the road to Paul da Serra.

cards.term: onde é que se apanha táxi?
cards.trans: where do you catch a taxi?
cards.note: apanhar — to catch (taxi, bus, sun, a cold)
cards.ex_t: Onde é que se apanha táxi a esta hora?
cards.ex_trans: Where do you catch a taxi at this hour?

cards.note: the emergency shout; 112 is the number
cards.ex_t: Socorro! Chamem uma ambulância!
cards.ex_trans: Help! Call an ambulance!

cards.term: chame a polícia, se faz favor
cards.ex_t: Houve um acidente — chame a polícia, se faz favor.
cards.ex_trans: There's been an accident — call the police, please.

cards.note: roubaram-me — they robbed me of; no passive needed
cards.ex_t: Roubaram-me a carteira no mercado.
cards.ex_trans: My wallet was stolen at the market.

cards.note: telemóvel — the pt-PT word; celular is Brazilian
cards.ex_t: Perdi o telemóvel algures na baixa.
cards.ex_trans: I lost my phone somewhere downtown.

cards.note: the freelancer's phrase for every form and small talk
cards.ex_t: Trabalho por conta própria, na área de dados.
cards.ex_trans: I'm self-employed, in data.

cards.note: estar de — the state you're in: de férias, de folga, de baixa
cards.ex_t: Esta semana estou de férias, respondo para a semana.
cards.ex_trans: I'm on holiday this week, I'll reply next week.

cards.note: pt-PT says para a semana where Brazil says semana que vem
cards.ex_t: Falamos para a semana, pode ser?
cards.ex_trans: Let's talk next week, alright?

cards.note: daqui a — from now: daqui a uma hora, daqui a nada
cards.ex_t: Saio daqui a bocado, espera por mim.
cards.ex_trans: I'm leaving in a bit, wait for me.

cards.note: agora mesmo — right now/just; no compound tense needed
cards.ex_t: Cheguei agora mesmo, ainda nem tirei o casaco.
cards.ex_trans: I just arrived, haven't even taken my coat off.

cards.note: valer a pena — to be worth the trouble
cards.ex_t: O teleférico é caro — vale a pena?
cards.ex_trans: The cable car is pricey — is it worth it?

cards.note: the most Portuguese answer to any question
cards.ex_t: — Chove lá em cima? — Depende do dia.
cards.ex_trans: — Does it rain up there? — Depends on the day.

cards.note: half instruction, half comfort
cards.ex_t: Calma, ainda temos tempo.
cards.ex_trans: Easy, we still have time.

cards.note: softer than 'esquece'; the lá carries the shrug
cards.ex_t: Deixa lá, não vale a pena discutir.
cards.ex_trans: Let it go, it's not worth arguing.

cards.trans: if it's not too much to ask
cards.note: futuro do conjuntivo in the wild — se for
cards.ex_t: Se não for pedir muito, pode verificar outra vez?
cards.ex_trans: If it's not too much to ask, could you check again?

cards.note: what the clerk says when it's your turn; also answers the phone
cards.ex_t: — Diga. — Bom dia, queria uma informação.
cards.ex_trans: — Yes? — Good morning, I'd like some information.

cards.note: the já makes it reassuringly close, whatever the truth
cards.ex_t: A farmácia? É já ali, ao virar da esquina.
cards.ex_trans: The pharmacy? Just over there, around the corner.

cards.ex_t: Há um café ao virar da esquina.
cards.ex_trans: There's a café around the corner.

cards.term: encha o depósito, se faz favor
cards.note: at the petrol station; gasóleo is diesel, gasolina is petrol
cards.ex_t: Encha o depósito com gasóleo, se faz favor.
cards.ex_trans: Fill it up with diesel, please.

cards.note: obras — the eternal Portuguese roadworks
cards.ex_t: O trilho está fechado para obras.
cards.ex_trans: The trail is closed for works.

cards.term: dá para fazer a levada hoje?
cards.trans: can the levada be done today?
cards.note: the Madeira question — weather decides
cards.ex_t: Com este tempo, dá para fazer a levada hoje?
cards.ex_trans: With this weather, can we do the levada today?

cards.ex_t: Olá! Há quanto tempo!
cards.ex_trans: Hi! Long time no see!

cards.note: the warm goodbye between acquaintances
cards.ex_t: Até amanhã, e cumprimentos à família!
cards.ex_trans: See you tomorrow, and regards to the family!

cards.note: said to anyone unwell — or their relatives
cards.ex_t: Estás constipado? As melhoras!
cards.ex_trans: You've got a cold? Get well soon!

cards.ex_t: Boa viagem, e manda fotos!
cards.ex_trans: Have a good trip, and send photos!

cards.note: farta if you're a woman; estar farto de — fed up with
cards.ex_t: Estou farto desta fila.
cards.ex_trans: I'm fed up with this queue.

cards.note: reassurance, stronger than não faz mal
cards.ex_t: Errar não tem mal nenhum — estás a aprender.
cards.ex_trans: Making mistakes is fine — you're learning.

cards.trans: this is a piece of cake
cards.note: canja is chicken soup — easy comfort
cards.ex_t: O exame A2? Isto é canja para ti.
cards.ex_trans: The A2 exam? Piece of cake for you.

cards.note: estar a par — to be in the know
cards.ex_t: Estive fora — põe-me a par das novidades.
cards.ex_trans: I was away — bring me up to speed.

cards.note: faz de conta que — pretend that
cards.ex_t: Faz de conta que não viste nada.
cards.ex_trans: Pretend you didn't see anything.

cards.note: opens polite questions and honest confessions alike
cards.ex_t: Por acaso sabe a que horas fecha a loja?
cards.ex_trans: Do you happen to know what time the shop closes?

cards.ex_t: Está caro, mas mesmo assim vou levar.
cards.ex_trans: It's expensive, but I'll take it anyway.

cards.note: the shrug that ends complaints
cards.ex_t: Perdemos o barco... enfim, é a vida.
cards.ex_trans: We missed the boat... oh well, that's life.

cards.ex_t: — O melhor bolo do Funchal? — Sem dúvida.
cards.ex_trans: — The best cake in Funchal? — Without a doubt.

cards.note: ainda bem que vieste — good thing you came
cards.ex_t: Ainda bem que trouxeste o guarda-chuva.
cards.ex_trans: Good thing you brought the umbrella.

cards.note: how every Portuguese story begins — imperfeito doing its job
cards.ex_t: Era uma vez uma ilha no meio do Atlântico.
cards.ex_trans: Once upon a time there was an island in the middle of the Atlantic.
